source_boundary: Original authored teaching scenarios aligned to supplied course; not copied assessment questions.

scenarios.title: Carrier Parents
scenarios.evidence: Two dominant-phenotype parents have an aa child, so both must supply a and therefore are Aa.

scenarios.title: Recessive × Carrier
scenarios.evidence: Each offspring has a 50% probability of the recessive phenotype; this does not guarantee one of every two children.

scenarios.title: Pedigree Constraint
scenarios.answer: Both parents must be Aa under the stated model.

scenarios.title: Possible Dominant Parent
scenarios.answer: A single percentage is not justified until the dominant parent's genotype is known.

scenarios.title: Independent Outcomes
scenarios.answer: The next outcome is not due; the same 25/50/25 probabilities apply to each pregnancy in this simplified model.

scenarios.title: Underdetermined Pedigree
scenarios.answer: Return both possible crosses, their probabilities, and a statement of uncertainty.
